provenance.source: Original synthetic workflow context. No measured readings, private case data or external dataset is included.
provenance.rights: Original schematic and synthetic context are supplied under the repository MIT licence; no third-party data or chart design is reproduced.
provenance.basis: Issue #2695 (2026), Purpose and deliverable 1: uncertainty loop and process-change feedback.
provenance.equations: None. No numerical engineering constant, coefficient, acceptance limit or forecasting equation is used. Engineering criteria are required inputs.
provenance.ai_use: AI-assisted chart implementation. This page illustrates an evidence workflow; it performs no AI prediction, agentic monitoring or automated engineering decision.

evidence.label: Inspection readings
evidence.required: Dated, located readings with method, calibration and measurement uncertainty.
evidence.missing: All numerical readings and their qualification records are required inputs.

evidence.label: Survey evidence
evidence.required: Dated observations with location, coverage and detection limitations.
evidence.missing: Survey observations, coverage and detection evidence are required inputs.

evidence.label: Metocean records
evidence.required: Time-aligned conditions with source, sampling basis and coverage.
evidence.missing: Metocean time series and applicability evidence are required inputs.

evidence.label: Operations records
evidence.required: Dated operating states, interventions and process-change records.
evidence.missing: Operating history and change records are required inputs.

steps.label: Measure
steps.input: Inspection readings, survey evidence, metocean and operations records enter the common evidence table.
steps.output: A time-aligned evidence register retaining units, provenance and qualification gaps.
steps.missing: Dated readings, coverage, calibration and process history are absent in this synthetic schematic.
steps.criterion: Required input: maintainer-defined evidence quality and coverage criteria before fitting a trend.

steps.label: Model
steps.input: Qualified evidence register and a documented process-history basis.
steps.output: A proposed trend model with its validity period, assumptions and validation needs.
steps.missing: A common dated thickness record and an independently tested forecasting basis are required.
steps.criterion: Required input: a validation method and acceptance criteria; a short-record fit alone does not establish forecast skill.

steps.label: Quantify uncertainty
steps.input: Proposed model, measurement uncertainty and model assumptions.
steps.output: A proposed uncertainty definition separating latent trend from future observation uncertainty.
steps.missing: Coverage, noise assumptions, uncertainty propagation and validation evidence are required.
steps.criterion: Required input: the band meaning, coverage and validation criteria before interpreting any uncertainty range.

steps.label: Decide
steps.input: Evidence gaps, validated forecasts if available, and stated decision criteria.
steps.output: NOT_EVALUATED: collect missing evidence and obtain maintainer review before choosing an inspection or intervention.
steps.missing: An engineering threshold, inspection policy and validated likelihood mapping are absent.
steps.criterion: Required input: applicable engineering limits and an inspection decision rule. Remaining life is not probability of failure.

steps.label: Reinspect
steps.input: A reviewed inspection plan with its scope, timing and required measurement quality.
steps.output: New dated readings and coverage evidence return to Measure for reconciliation with the historical record.
steps.missing: An approved inspection plan and new observations are required; no inspection date is calculated.
steps.criterion: Required input: a reviewed inspection interval and evidence collection plan; reconcile new observations before reusing a trend.

feedback.trigger: A process change, intervention or changed operating state is recorded in the operations evidence.
feedback.action: Reassess the historical trend at Model: review whether earlier readings represent the changed conditions, document the valid period and re-quantify uncertainty before deciding again. No change point is detected by this page.
